evidence.observation: Growth started ~11 °C above 750 °C setpoint but converged smoothly to setpoint by t≈2700 s; normal controller settling.
Brief pressure excursion 3.06→~3.30 Torr from k=114 to k=125, returning to baseline at k=126; no accompanying Ar, O2 or T change.
Cooldown transition executed as expected: Ar to 200 sccm, heater power to ~0, T falling monotonically ~0.4 °C/s.
Exhaust O2 stable at 3-6 ppm throughout, no leak signature.

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (Raman/AFM/optical) of the sample; also a repeat of the transient pressure bump to confirm it was benign (e.g., momentary exhaust restriction) rather than an intermittent fault.
